subject: geom_bar(aes(x=facor, y=..density..)) no longer seems to work

messages.author: ae44f3beb7bcd7f8
messages.subject: geom_bar(aes(x=facor, y=..density..)) no longer seems to work
parts:
It seems that "..density.." no longer works for geom_bar. Is this expected behavior in ggplot2 version 2.0? for example:

g=ggplot(mtcars)

g+geom_bar(aes(x=factor(cyl),y= ..density..,fill=factor(carb)))

Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'density' not found

This code previously worked in earlier versions of ggplot2, so, I'm confused how I should go about summarizing over factors.

Thanks much!

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: geom_bar(aes(x=facor, y=..density..)) no longer seems to work
parts:
I believe that is expected. See ?geom_bar ?stat_count and ?geom_histogram for details, but long story short you should use geom_histogram. There are some notes about this in the release notes as well.

Best,
Ista
